series.title: The Inner Path
series.description: Classic writings of Islamic spirituality in early English translations: Al-Ghazzali’s search for certainty and the mystic poetry of Rūmī, Sadi and Jāmī. Each volume is set out page by page, with notes and a glossary of unfamiliar words.

books.title: The Confessions of Al-Ghazzali
books.author: Al-Ghazzali
books.shortDescription: Al-Ghazzali’s own account of his crisis of doubt, his testing of theology, philosophy and esoteric teaching, and his turn to the Sufi path. Translated by Claud Field (1909).
